prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: log-aggregator
description: Ingests log lines and counts them by level.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /logs
  description: 'body {level: info|warn|error, message: non-empty string}; 202 when
    accepted; 400 for bad level, empty message or malformed JSON'
- method: GET
  path: /logs/stats
  description: '200 {counts: {info:n, warn:n, error:n}} with all three keys always
    present'
metrics:
- name: log_lines_info_total
  type: counter
  help: Info lines ingested
- name: log_lines_warn_total
  type: counter
  help: Warn lines ingested
- name: log_lines_error_total
  type: counter
  help: Error lines ingested
behaviors:
- Rejected lines are not counted
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /logs
  expect_status:
  - 202
  body: '{"level": "info", "message": "started"}'
- method: POST
  path: /logs
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"level": "bogus", "message": "x"}'
- method: POST
  path: /logs
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"level": "error", "message": ""}'
- method: GET
  path: /logs/stats
  expect_status:
  - 200
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- logLinesInfoTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `log_lines_info_total`; use Inc/Add
- logLinesWarnTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `log_lines_warn_total`; use Inc/Add
- logLinesErrorTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `log_lines_error_total`; use Inc/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /logs  body {level: info|warn|error, message: non-empty string}; 202 when accepted; 400 for bad level, empty message or malformed JSON
   - GET /logs/stats  200 {counts: {info:n, warn:n, error:n}} with all three keys always present
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
